name: Sepulchrine-Strath

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near impact-scarred wastelands that no expedition has ever claimed.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Regular pulses leave the ancient alien ruins aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
